description: This file declares functions related to managing request headers within the WebKit component of the WPEFramework. It includes necessary WebKit and WPE headers, and defines functions to set, remove, and apply request headers for WebKit bundle pages.

methods.name: SetRequestHeaders
methods.description: Sets request headers for a given WKBundlePageRef using specified WKTypeRef headers.

methods.name: RemoveRequestHeaders
methods.description: Removes request headers from the specified WKBundlePageRef.

methods.name: ApplyRequestHeaders
methods.description: Applies request headers to a specified WKURLRequestRef within a WKBundlePageRef.
